source.content: public class DataSourceCompileShapeProbe { public void referencesOnly() { DataSource.Column column = DataSource.Column.text('Name', 'Name', 80); column.description = 'desc'; column.filterable = true; column.picklistValues = new List<Map<String,String>>(); DataSource.Table tableRef = new DataSource.Table(); tableRef.columns = new List<DataSource.Column>{ column }; tableRef.labelSingular = 'Account'; DataSource.Order order = new DataSource.Order(); order.tableName = 'Account'; order.columnName = 'Name'; order.direction = DataSource.OrderDirection.ASCENDING; DataSource.TableSelection selection = new DataSource.TableSelection(); selection.tableSelected = tableRef.name; selection.filter = new DataSource.Filter(); selection.order = new List<DataSource.Order>{ order }; DataSource.QueryContext queryContext = new DataSource.QueryContext(); queryContext.tableSelection = selection; DataSource.TableResult tableResult = new DataSource.TableResult(); tableResult.rows = new List<Map<String,Object>>(); DataSource.SearchContext searchContext = new DataSource.SearchContext(new List<DataSource.Table>{ tableRef }, 0, 10, new List<DataSource.TableSelection>{ selection }, 'acme'); DataSource.DeleteResult deleteResult = DataSource.DeleteResult.success('ext-1'); DataSource.UpsertResult upsertResult = DataSource.UpsertResult.failure('ext-2', 'missing'); DataSource.ConnectionParams params = new DataSource.ConnectionParams(); params.protocol = DataSource.AuthenticationProtocol.PASSWORD; params.principalType = DataSource.IdentityType.NAMED_USER; DataSource.Provider provider; List<DataSource.Capability> capabilities = provider.getCapabilities(); List<DataSource.AuthenticationCapability> auth = provider.getAuthenticationCapabilities(); DataSource.Connection connection = provider.getConnection(params); List<DataSource.Table> tables = connection.sync(); List<DataSource.TableResult> searched = connection.search(searchContext); tableResult.success = deleteResult.success && upsertResult.success; } }
